name: LANCET Nano

calibration.method: positive-slope group/class-balanced Platt on INT8 risk logits; reported score only

bands: risk logit >= riskyLogitThreshold: risky; >= reviewLogitThreshold: review; otherwise not_flagged
reviewThresholdRule: dev-matched INT8 authored-core safe interruption ~2.00% (1.99% realized on 3,314 held-out dev safe rows)
riskyThresholdRule: dev-matched INT8 authored-core safe block ~0.60% (0.57% realized on 3,314 held-out dev safe rows)
askHead: diagnostic only; never sets the band
shellRiskInDistributionDisclosure: ShellRisk-Bench train and test splits (excluding GPL gtfobins/nl2bash) were fitted per owner authorization; Bench 3 core and Neutral remain unseen.
